control_events: ((UNITYSELECTION="RETAIL" AND NOT EPIC_PRODUCT_UPGRADE) OR (UNITYSELECTION="TRYOUT" AND TRYOUTRELEASE)) AND (EPIV) AND USERNAME<>"" AND SERIALNUMBER<>"" AND USERNAME_EMPTY_AFTERTRIM<>"1"
